checked: watch-list found: most-read lists, viral incident (Bundaran HI declaration), disasters (Anak Krakatau, West Aceh flood, BMKG waves), karhutla/haze health, crime, haji, public-service scams

events.event: KPU commissioner Idham Holik responds to the MA ruling on Gibran's SMA-equivalence letter, saying the 2024 election stages ended with the inauguration and KPU's duties are finished, while Golkar says it will study the ruling and PD's Jansen says Gibran should resign or be removed.
events.key_numbers: MA decision 742 K/TUN/2026 · letter No. 9149/D.D1/KS/2019 dated 6 Aug 2019 · PTUN Jakarta case 62/G/2026/PTUN.JKT · KPU cites Art. 167(4)(k) and Art. 3(d) of Law 7/2017
events.why_it_matters: It shows who, if anyone, can act on the ruling about the sitting Vice President's candidacy paper.

events.event: Polda Metro Jaya apologised over the viral 29 Oct 'Deklarasi Sumpah Pemuda Mahasiswa Indonesia 2026' at Pospol Bundaran HI, saying presidential special envoy Raffi Ahmad and creator Willie Salim attended as invited guests and that it was not a counter to the previous day's student demonstration.
events.key_numbers: Event 29 Oct 2026 (98th Sumpah Pemuda) · apology 31 Oct · police probing alleged 'mahasiswa gadungan' (fake students) among participants
events.why_it_matters: A police-hosted 'student' event a day after a protest raised public questions about staged youth support.
events.spreading_evidence: Viral per outlets (Republika, JPNN, Detik); Detik terpopuler #10 on Willie Salim withdrawing from a Solo concert is a related spin-off

events.event: Anak Krakatau erupted repeatedly on the evening of 31 Oct while staying at Level III (Siaga), with PVMBG keeping a 5 km exclusion radius.
events.key_numbers: Level III (Siaga) · 5 km radius · 1 km bar near new island (NW/SE) · first eruption ~18:30 WIB · outlets report 12 eruptions that night (Okezone, Sindonews headlines)
events.why_it_matters: Residents around the Sunda Strait need to know the alert level and no-go zone.
events.spreading_evidence: Multiple outlets incl. CNN Indonesia, Detik, Liputan6, RRI

events.event: The Indonesian Pediatric Society (IDAI) warned that children exposed to forest-fire haze face a risk of stunting, alongside lung and brain harm.
events.key_numbers: No figures verified from the article body
events.why_it_matters: Gives parents in haze regions a health angle beyond coughs, tied to the corporate-suspect story.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia, Berita Satu, IDN Times and others

events.event: Police in East Java say Dwi Bagus Martono, 40, killed his secret wife and her 4-year-old son, allegedly tried to destroy the bodies and hid at a spiritual retreat in Jombang before his 25 Oct arrest.
events.key_numbers: Victims aged 30 and 4 · missing since 20 Sep 2026 · arrested 25 Oct 2026 · hid ~2 weeks in Gudo, Jombang
events.why_it_matters: A high-profile crime case, but police allegations only and no charges reported yet.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia nasional coverage; not seen on most-read lists

events.event: Police raided a narcotics hotspot in Kampung Bahari, North Jakarta, in a coordinated operation in which officers rode a KRL commuter train to the site.
events.why_it_matters: A visually striking police tactic against a known drug-trade area.

events.event: Deputy Hajj Minister said non-Muslims may serve as hajj officers.
events.why_it_matters: Likely to spark religious debate over who may run the pilgrimage.

events.event: Bareskrim raided a syndicate hoarding subsidised diesel in Bandung.
events.why_it_matters: Subsidised fuel diverted by hoarders affects supply and prices for ordinary users.

events.event: A flood-damaged bridge cut access to two villages in West Aceh, and BMKG warned of waves up to 4 m in the southern waters of East Java.
events.key_numbers: 2 villages cut off · waves up to 4 m
events.why_it_matters: Rainy-season hazards affect travel and fishing in affected regions.

events.event: Antara ran a warning about scams posing as wage-subsidy (BSU) aid.
events.why_it_matters: Fake aid links phish personal data, a repeat pattern in bansos hoaxes.
